status_summary.critical_issue: Target edge functions fpl-live-sync, finalize-gameweek, sync-manager-data return 404 Not Found due to missing deployment code.

core_architectural_flaws: No Matchday Concept: Gameweek is incorrectly treated as a single sync & finalization event instead of multiple calendar Matchdays.
Stale Manager Rankings: Manager points update only once daily at 07:00 WIB from static entry history API. Live player points are never aggregated into live manager points in real-time.
Timezone & Fixture Blindness: fpl-daily-scheduler runs at 00:00 UTC (07:00 WIB) without checking if fixtures exist today in WIB timezone (Asia/Jakarta).
Missing Matchday Finalization: Intermediate matchday dates receive zero final data sync or snapshot locks.

scenario_recovery_gaps.live_goal_scored: Player live points update is missed due to 404 live sync. Manager points and Kino league rank lag by 12+ hours until 07:00 WIB next day.
scenario_recovery_gaps.no_fixtures_today: Cron fires 1,440 times/day 404 errors. Lacks self-gating kickoff window check.

fpl_data_sync_cron_audit.p0_action_item: Create & deploy unified fpl-live-sync edge function with self-gating fixture window check, /api/event/{gw}/live/ ingestion, and real-time live manager score calculation.

features_implemented: Visual Status Badges ([ LIVE · PROVISIONAL ] vs [ FINAL REVIEW ])
Timeline snapshot cards for multi-update GWs
Mobile responsive layout & clean empty states
